---
title: "Reference"
---

Four functions are exported. Each one has a help page in the installed package,
so `?run_app` works too.

## `run_app(...)`

Starts the game. It registers `inst/app/www` as a Shiny resource path and then
calls `shiny::shinyApp()`, passing `...` straight through. Returns the app
object, which starts the app when printed.

## `app_ui()`

Builds the interface: the Game, Settings and About tabs, plus the footer. It
reads `style.css` and `about_footer.html` from the installed package through
`system.file()`, so it works from any working directory.

## `app_server(input, output, session)`

Holds the game state and the rules. Guesses are lowercased before they are
matched, and the match is fixed rather than a regular expression, so a dot
guess means a literal dot.

## `hangman_data()`

Returns the CRAN snapshot as a data frame with `Package`, `Author`,
`Description` and `n_char`, the last being the length of the package name that
the difficulty setting filters on. The CSV is parsed the first time you call
it and cached for the rest of the R session.

```r
head(hangman_data()[, c("Package", "n_char")])
```

## Layout

```
R/                     app_ui, app_server, run_app, hangman_data
inst/app/www/          style.css, about_footer.html
inst/extdata/          pkgdata.csv
app.R                  loads the package and calls run_app(), for shinyapps.io
quarto/                source for this site, rendered into docs/
```
